resources.string: Protection pincodes are kept only on the device where they were set and never move to another one. Set them up again on this device.
Show the Contacts and Calls tabs in the tab bar. When off, Contacts and Recent Calls open from Settings.

Each locked chat opens only with its own pincode. The master pincode turns Chat Lock on and is the recovery key: if you forget a chat\'s pincode, entering the master pincode on that chat\'s screen opens the chat and removes its lock.\n\nA locked chat hides its message previews in this app\'s chat list and in-app banners. This is a local lock in this app on this device, not encryption; pincodes stay on this device only and are not carried to a new one.
Biometrics can stand in for the master pincode on its own screens. After a biometrics change on this device, the pincode is required again.

The master pincode turns Chat Lock on and off and is the recovery key: on a locked chat\'s screen, \"Forgot pincode?\" takes the master pincode, opens the chat and removes its lock. Changing a chat\'s pincode with the master keeps the lock. After 4 wrong master entries, Chat Lock can be reset with this device\'s biometrics or screen lock.
Tap a chat to change its pincode, biometrics or remove the lock.
No locked chats yet. Add a chat and give it its own pincode. You can also hold a chat in the chat list or open its profile and choose \"Lock Chat\".
Chats hidden in the Secret Vault are locked from inside the vault.
Locked chats of other accounts on this device are managed from those accounts.
Removes the master pincode and every chat\'s pincode. Your messages are not deleted. The Secret Vault is not affected.
Some locked chats have no master pincode, so a forgotten chat pincode has no way back. Set a master pincode to add \"Forgot pincode?\" to every locked chat, or turn Chat Lock off below.
There is no master pincode to ask for, so turning Chat Lock off confirms it\'s you with this device\'s biometrics or screen lock. Removes every chat\'s pincode. Your messages are not deleted.
Chat Lock cannot be read right now. Unlock this device, wait a moment and open this screen again.
The lock type (PIN or password) is chosen while changing the pincode.
Forgot the current pincode? The master pincode is accepted instead and the lock is kept.
Biometrics open this chat instead of its pincode. After a biometrics change on this device, the pincode is required once.
Forgot it? The master pincode is accepted instead.
Enter the current code to change it
Enter the current code to remove the lock
Enter the code to turn on biometrics for this chat
Enter the current master pincode to change it
Enter the master pincode to turn on biometrics
Confirms it\'s you; then set this chat\'s new pincode
Confirms it\'s you; then this chat\'s lock is removed
Master pincode: turns Chat Lock on and is the recovery key
First a master pincode: it turns Chat Lock on and is your recovery key. Then pick the first chat to lock and give it its own pincode.
Two short steps: first a master pincode (it turns Chat Lock on and is your recovery key), then this chat\'s own pincode.
A master pincode: it turns Chat Lock on and is the recovery key for the chats already locked.
Confirm your identity to turn off Chat Lock
Showing results from this device only.
Confirm the vault PIN to change how the vault opens
